reviews.text: Kindness, helpfulness, quality service, and skill: I have no other words to describe this little corner of paradise for our four-legged friends. Micol is now the only person I entrust my poodle to with complete trust, always confident of a result that will far exceed my expectations. Superb :)
Very sweet and professional, Alma loves them!!!
The best of the best. Highly recommended!
The best groom my toy poodle ever had
The only place in Milan where I could find accessories and coats for my greyhound! Micol is welcoming and professional and always knows how to recommend the right thing! Excellent!
Very positive experience.

Pet à Porter:
fashion shop & spa beauty room for our coolest four-legged friends in Milan!
Micol, with her enthusiasm and love for animals, always welcomes you with big smiles, fun, and who knows, a few bubbles!
A remarkable selection of outfits makes everything even more "Magick."
In addition to having tons of highly appreciated toys, Mio Dio,
My cat LOVES it!
🤍

I had an excellent experience at Pet à Porter Milano.
The products are of the highest quality, carefully selected, and the level of professionalism is truly rare.

Micol, the owner, welcomes you with warmth and attention, making you feel right at home.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for the best for their pet!
The best place to bring your furry friend! Micol is super friendly and helpful, and has a huge selection of fantastic products, both made in Italy and handmade. Super cool! :)

After a 2-week holiday in Norway & Italy, our little furkid, Cola was in a bad need of a bath, especially after rolling and playing with snow and running around wet streets. It was so great that Pet à Porter was able to accommodate us even after their business hours as we arrived back in Milan from an overnight trip to Rome. They patiently waited for us even when we lost directions to the store (my fault entirely!).

Cola is typically more reserved with strangers but amazingly she felt so at home and played with the groomer Michela (hope I got the spelling correct!) and owner Micol. And a pawrent knows the furkid is happy when she does her zoomies!!!

Thank you Micol and Michela for your professional service and dedication to caring for one furkid at a time. Whenever our friends and their furkid visit Milan, we will sure to recommend Pet à Porter!!

Hi, I'm Miwa, a little Japanese samurai.
Today my uncle took me to Micol and Michela, who, between scratches and treats, pampered me and gave me a spa-worthy treatment.
Wonderful. Tomorrow, I'll recommend the park to all my friends.
Now I feel much more relaxed.
Pet a porter is a fabulous store but the most AMAZING groomer!! I am so glad I found them 🐶 …
Pet a Porter is a special place and Micol and Michela are extremely kind and welcoming.

We took our Cocker Spaniel to these wonderful ladies for a grooming session and we're thrilled with how they groomed Ginny.
They're knowledgeable and absolutely delightful with both dogs and their owners!

Fantastic and knowledgeable girls.
Amazing place!
They were very kind and when my India was finished with her bath and treatment she was very happy and almost seemed to be smiling!! In addition to being very clean and soft ❤️ highly recommended!

I bought this onesie for my greyhound, Lilly 💖, and it's simply gorgeous!! Super soft fabric and bright colors! They were helpful and kind in helping me choose the perfect item for my dog! I will definitely buy clothes and accessories for my four-legged friends from this boutique again! …

A wonderful pet Boutique full of colorful coats, jackets, sweaters and other accessories for dogs of all shapes and sizes. I especially enjoyed the selection of coats made by hand for Greyhounds of all sizes as it's hard to find a shop that caters to the breed. I can’t wait to go back and visit to see the new collection!
Best dog groomer in town! The only place I take my greyhounds.
Excellent service! Even though my dog ​​Pipo isn't easy to handle, they were patient, kind, and very professional.

My Gigì went in like a swiffer and came out like a princess 😍
Perfect toilet, done with care and sweetness
You girls are amazing! …
this place is amazing! not only is their service impeccable, but they truly care for your dog like its their own! 100% recommend!
It was a wonderful experience. I brought my wary pug for grooming. Thanks to the kindness of the staff, it was a wonderful experience that we will repeat soon.

You can tell Micol and Michela work with passion and love for our furry friends: the grooming service is very thorough (my poodle was a complex case :) ) and the shop offers a very original selection of quality products and accessories. Bravo!
Very kind and super competent!!

I brought back a messy teddy bear after the summer. Michela did a fantastic job.

A small, charming shop that I'll never leave again.

Thanks for
Recently discovered but already a reference point for threading my puppy 🩷🩷 …

A wonderful place where my kitty relaxes every time he goes to the bathroom. 🙃🤗
Since I've been buying the food recommended by Micol, his fur is much more beautiful.
A special thanks to this gem of a place.

We just picked up our poodle 🐩 Jack. Competence, courtesy, and professionalism. We are very satisfied. Definitely a pleasant discovery that will become a pleasant habit. Thank you so much to Michela and Micol. …

Highly recommended! My dog ​​had never been stripped anywhere else, and I could also see from the videos that they were doing it that she was finally calm while bathing, she was relaxed!
I couldn't have wished for more for my little Bea!
Thanks, girls.

Impeccable service
I took my dachshund to be stripped and I couldn't be more satisfied! The treatment was performed with extreme professionalism and kindness, respecting her schedule and without stressing her. The result is fantastic. Her fur is neat, clean, and perfectly groomed. It's not easy to find a good stripper in Milan.
Plus, the environment was clean, welcoming, and relaxing, which really helped put her at ease (and she's certainly not easy to convince!). You can tell there's real passion and expertise behind it.
Thank you so much, Micol and Michela, keep up the good work!
We'll definitely be back! 🐾
Thank you!🙏 …
Accessories and services that keep pace with new needs: Micol has a focus on everyone! Thank you so much! 🐕🫶🏻 …
A little paradise where two angels, Micol and Michela, pamper our furry friends and make them feel right at home. Olga's and my new favorite place ♥️

I always take my Pomeranian Willy to Micol and Michela, and after every session, he comes home smelling wonderful, with his fur incredibly soft and perfectly groomed. Precise cuts, no tangles, and attention to detail, like his nails and ear cleaning. Highly recommended, and thanks again, ladies!

It was the first time I took my dog ​​Didi to Pet à Porter, and we were incredibly happy with the result!
Didi came home smelling wonderful, beautiful, and cared for down to the smallest detail.
I wholeheartedly recommend this place and trust them completely, because I know how much passion, love, and dedication Micol, the owner, puts into her work.
Plus, I've known Michela for a while and can attest to her incredible skill as a groomer!
Maximum efficiency, taste, etiquette, and courtesy. The best spot in Milan.

I brought my dog ​​(Italian Greyhound) for a bath and was really satisfied! Micol was extremely kind and professional, and she made little Yumi feel at ease, as she was having her first bath. The bath was thorough, and Yumi smelled wonderful afterwards! The shop was clean, tidy, and welcoming. I will definitely be back! Highly recommended for anyone looking for animal care and attention.

My Baloo received a perfect complete grooming service. The staff were incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and kind. They have a love for animals and a passion for their work: I recommend them to everyone!

Super nice, kind, and, above all, professional.
They literally fixed a horrible haircut that others had given my poodle ♥️❤️♥️… and, thanks to them, she's beautiful again!
A very cute, welcoming, and spotlessly clean little place!
I couldn't have asked for anything better.
Highly recommended.
A beautiful corner of paradise for four-legged friends, super-stocked! Excellent value for money! Recommended!
Beautiful shop, fantastic grooming service, Michela is super kind and gentle and the grooming is a pleasant and relaxing moment for my little dog! Highly recommended!
A wonderful shop, just like its owner, who is incredibly kind and helpful. Quality products that are hard to find elsewhere.

Perfect shop for my naughty kids!
It's worth a look just to see some really beautiful things and a great selection of baby food! P.S. The owner is a sweetheart, be careful, she'll sell you the world... 😂 …

A wonderful discovery; quality is the perfect word for this new opening.

Micol, the owner, is a true expert ☺️
See you next time!

A little gem for our beloved four-legged friends. A delightful shop and a kind and attentive owner! Beautiful, but above all, high-quality products! We needed it!! Highly recommended! I'll definitely be back!!
Handsome
